modalities.evidence: longitudinal task-free functional and anatomical data

output.population: 36 Wistar rats (18 male and 18 female), scanned across 5 developmental timepoints at approximately postnatal day 28, 35, 49, 70 and 91
output.summary: Longitudinal task-free functional and anatomical MRI in developing rats, scanned at five ages on a 7T scanner, with puberty onset, oestrous smears, body weights and preprocessing derivatives in BIDS format.
